lines.text: There was one day when Shiva himself broke. This is that day.

parts.text: There was one day when Shiva himself broke.

lines.text: Sati loved Shiva. Her father, King Daksha, despised him.

parts.text: Her father, King Daksha, despised him.

lines.text: Daksha held a great fire ceremony, and invited every god. Except one.

parts.text: Daksha held a great fire ceremony, and invited every god.

lines.text: Sati went anyway. Her father mocked Shiva before them all. Heartbroken, she gave her life to the sacred fire.

parts.text: Her father mocked Shiva before them all.
she gave her life to the sacred fire.

lines.text: Shiva felt it from Kailash. He lifted her in his arms, and walked across the whole world.

parts.text: He lifted her in his arms,
and walked across the whole world.

lines.text: His grief became the Tandava. The dance that shakes creation.
And when the storm was spent, he sat down on Kailash, closed his eyes, and went still.

parts.text: And when the storm was spent,

lines.text: Even Shiva had to sit with his pain. That is where meditation begins.
